'''Steler''' was a [[bannerman]] of the [[Tower Guard]] during the [[Aiel War]]. 

==Appearance==
Bannerman Steler is a tall and grizzled man who has a deep, gravelly voice.

==History==
At the end of the [[Aiel War]], Bannerman Steler and several of the [[Tower Guard]] are tasked to escort [[Accepted]] into the camps surrounding the [[White Tower]]. Steler escorts [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]].{{ref/book|0|4}} Due to Moiraine and Siuan wanting to get every last name, they are somewhat late in coming back to the Tower. Steler and [[Malvin]] hustle to get them back safely.{{ref/book|0|5}}
